identity.title: Derive terminal truth and finish in one idempotent command

values.task_boundary: Implement only the first serialized closeout-simplification slice: derived terminal truth and one idempotent finish command with compatibility reads; leave cleanup and deletion to #5779 and #5780.
deliverables: Derived terminal resolver and typed result schemas
Exact-head and idempotent finish integration tests
Updated operator manifest and focused documentation
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One implementation issue needs one PR and successful finish creates no tracked post-merge diff or second PR
AC-2: Exact-head review, required checks, publication identity, and expected-SHA merge protection remain fail-closed
AC-3: Already-merged, interrupted-after-merge, and concurrent finish calls converge idempotently
AC-4: Merged, closed-unmerged, and approved no-PR outcomes derive from live GitHub and immutable Git truth
AC-5: Terminal remote state makes stale local claims non-blocking without deleting dirty work
AC-6: Legacy terminal records and receipts remain readable without rewrite
AC-7: Focused Gate 4-7 tests and strict Clippy pass
dependencies: GitHub API and Git graph remain canonical remote authorities
non_goals: Standalone cleanup implementation owned by follow-on #5779
Runtime, provider, ADL language, or deployment changes
